name: meddpicc-demo
description: MEDDPICC from call notes to a governed Salesforce update (working title)

scripts.types: wrangler types --strict-vars=false -c workers/gatekeeper/wrangler.jsonc workers/gatekeeper/worker-configuration.d.ts && wrangler types --strict-vars=false -c workers/agent/wrangler.jsonc -c workers/gatekeeper/wrangler.jsonc workers/agent/worker-configuration.d.ts
scripts.build:check: wrangler deploy --dry-run -c workers/gatekeeper/wrangler.jsonc && wrangler deploy --dry-run -c workers/agent/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.sf:deploy: sf project deploy start -o meddpicc -d salesforce/main
scripts.test: vitest run --root workers/gatekeeper && vitest run --root workers/agent
